t: You're on Sugden Road, a residential street in the London Borough of Wandsworth. It's an ordinary street of homes, and a few of the people who have lived here are on record. Virginia Kathleen Seymour was born in 1955, and Simon John Moxon was born in 1965. Beyond that there's little recorded about them, so this is simply a street where real Londoners have made their homes.
